proposal.blind_spot: Store-side coalescing and grid-level parallelism are invisible: writes are up to half of DRAM traffic but only load efficiency is measured, and sub-saturated DRAM cannot be attributed to too-few-blocks versus a true bandwidth ceiling.

rationale.smsp__sass_average_data_bytes_per_sector: HIGH -> stores are coalesced and write traffic is irreducible, so attack the read side (fuse producers, remove re-reads) or accept near-optimality instead of adding instructions; LOW -> stores are scattered, so re-index for contiguous warp-wide writes, e.g., stage tiles via shared memory for permute/transpose/roll/flip patterns.
rationale.launch__waves_per_multiprocessor: LOW (<1) -> grid underfills the GPU, so increase parallelism (more programs, smaller BLOCK, 2D decomposition, split rows across programs); HIGH -> grid already saturates SMs, so stop adding parallelism and cut DRAM bytes or fix access patterns.
